purpose: Pre-publication review of a renewed Korean Querydsl article and its first English edition

newEnglishEdition.policy: Set the new English publication and modification timestamps at publication preparation after user approval; preserve the Korean original publication date.

selection.basis: Complete the Spring Boot migration topic with a reproducible Querydsl/Jakarta example.
selection.searchEvidence: Last fetched 28-day page data recorded one impression and no clicks for the legacy Querydsl setup URL, and nine impressions for the multi-frontend Gradle URL. No returned query rows for these candidates. This does not establish search demand.

scope.korean: Rewrite existing guide while preserving URL, original publication date and migration provenance.
scope.english: First edition, using a new 2026 publication timestamp rather than the 2023 source date.
scope.inboundLink: Add one contextual link from the English Spring Boot migration guide.

independentAIReview.mode: Read-only, context separated from author; static article/code review and primary-source browsing. No Gradle execution by reviewer, and no human/native-speaker review.

findings.issue: The checker did not verify or record the actual Gradle/JVM versions.
findings.resolution: Require Gradle8.4/JVM17 and print the actual JVM patch.

findings.issue: Korean sorting and English collation described slightly different unverified database behavior.
findings.resolution: Use strings comparison and collation wording in Korean.

execution.source: The same five project files extracted from both article editions
checks: QEmployee source in the documented Gradle default path
No generated QEmployee under handwritten src tree
execution.limits: H2 sample only; no production SQL dialect, collation, locking or migration validation.

ci: The Querydsl extraction checker is configured after the existing Gradle8.4 setup; CI status is tracked in the PR.
